text:
Samir: ran a multi-node perf sweep this morning enabling FP8 on both H100 and L40S. saw expected throughput gains on short prompts, but for long-context workloads (~16k tokens) on L40S the end-to-end tail latency increases and throughput drops compared to INT8. suspect KV cache eviction thrash + kernel fallback during generation.
Priya: can you paste the perf numbers and the exact config you used?
Samir: here are the critical bits:
```
model: redwood-open-xxl
hw: L40S x1 per-worker
te_config: {
  enable_fp8: true
  fp8_mode: hybrid
  autocast: true
  fp8_calib: ema
}
batching: dynamic, max_batch_size=64
kv_cache: warmup_threshold=0.7, eviction_policy=LRU, eviction_target=0.2
```
Throughput short (128 tokens): INT8 420 tok/s, FP8 520 tok/s
Throughput long (16k): INT8 35 tok/s, FP8 18 tok/s
Tail p95 latency long: INT8 900ms, FP8 1.8s

Jules: that delta is huge. do you see any kernel fallback logs during the long runs? like falling back to slowpath quant kernel?
Samir: yes, logs show repeated kernel selection churn. sequence of kernel IDs switching mid-request. snippet: `kernel_selector: picked kernel_fp8_fused_qa -> fallback_int8_dotprod -> kernel_fp8_split_attn` repeated. looks like kernel election is unstable when sequence length grows and KV cache hits/misses oscillate.
Morgan: this looks like interplay between TE autocast thresholds and our kernel sampler. if the runtime sees large activation scale shifts mid-generation, TE might switch quant kernels. plausible calibration drift under long prefix/prompt.
Alex: which TE version? we had a recent change to `autocast_sample_window` in 0.5.9 that could cause frequent switches if window too small.
Samir: TE 0.5.9 on L40S. autocast_sample_window=128 by default. when I increased to 1024 the churn reduced and p95 improved (~1.1s) but still worse than INT8.
Priya: any KV cache metrics? misses, eviction rate?
Samir: yes: eviction rate jumps from 0.02 to 0.48 during long requests. KV stored_size oscillates, GC/evict runs every ~120ms under FP8 run. seems batching behavior + cache eviction cause microbatches to see different memory layout -> kernel selector perceives different occupancy and switches kernels.
Jules: interesting. we should confirm whether the kernel election is based on per-microbatch occupancy vs global model config. if it's per-microbatch, instability will happen as you said. can you repro deterministically with synthetic sequences?
Samir: repro script posted below: `./perf/repro_fp8_kv_thrash --model redwood-open-xxl --len 16000 --batch 1 --te 0.5.9 --kv-warmup 0.7` produces the churn 9/10 runs on L40S. H100 runs do not show the same level of fallback.
Morgan: H100 has a different kernel set and more stable FP8 tensor cores; L40S FP8 kernels route through different codepaths that are more sensitive to activation exponents. maybe our quant calibration (ema) is underestimating scale for long tails. try `fp8_calib: moving_max` instead of `ema`.
Samir: tried moving_max, got slight quality variance but perf recovered to ~30 tok/s for long runs (much better). so calibration algorithm matters a lot for stability.
Alex: we should also look at batching heuristics. dynamic batching currently merges queues and forms microbatches with variable seq lengths; when a long sequence enters it forces others to pad and may change kernel choice. a possible mitigation: prefer homogeneous batch packing for FP8 workloads or isolate long-context traffic onto INT8 nodes.
Priya: do we see quality regressions with moving_max on production eval sets?
Samir: small BLEU/ROUGE drift in some calibration-sensitive prompts, but within tolerance for most customers. we need dedicated evals.
Jules: action items: 1) Samir to open a regression issue with logs and repro. 2) Morgan + Alex to instrument kernel_selector to report reason codes when switching (e.g., occupancy_threshold, scale_shift, memory_pressure). 3) Priya to run calibration-eval harness across fp8_calib modes. 4) Ops: consider routing long-context traffic away from L40S FP8 pool until we have mitigation.
Samir: creating issue: https://redwood/infra/issue/12345 (posted). attaching a small flamegraph and kernel-selection timeline.
bench-bot: deploy started for patch branch `fp8-kernel-stabilize` on eng-runtime-canary (build id bld-20260318.3) :rocket:
Morgan: for the kernel_selector change, I propose adding a hysteresis window: once a kernel is chosen for a stream, require N microbatches or a stable metric for M ms before switching. should reduce oscillation.
Alex: agreed. add a metric `kernel_switch_rate` to per-request trace and alert if > 0.1/s.
Priya: I'll prioritize running an eval sweep across 3 calib modes (ema, moving_max, hist_peak) overnight and post numbers in the morning.
Samir: thanks all — I'll pin the repro artifacts and mark the issue high-priority. if anyone can reproduce locally on an L40S dev box ping me and I'll drop the dataset. :thumbsup:
